ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Me he quedado dormido aquí
como quien no quiere la cosa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}En fin,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} supongo que necesito
cargar las pilas. ¡Buenas noches!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Je me suis endormi sans faire
exprès, j'imagine{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bon,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} je vais aller me coucher bien
sagement dans mon lit. Dodo !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Galiba yine yanlışlıkla
ayakta uyuyakalmışım{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Neyse,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} uslu
bir çocuk olup şimdi
yatağa gideyim. İyi geceler!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ah, you're finally here,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}I expected you to come to see me a
lot sooner, and I guess I fell asleep
waiting,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Te estaba esperando,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Has tardado tanto que no he tenido
más remedio que descansar un poco
la vista,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Aa, sonunda geldin,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Beni
çok daha önce görmeye gelirsin
diye bekliyordum; beklerken
uyuyakalmışım,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}I must have been really tired to
fall asleep while standing up.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}If you didn't wake me,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} I would
have gone back to sleep again.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
Thank you,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Dovevo essere proprio stanco per
essermi addormentato in piedi.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Se non mi avessi svegliato tu,
avrei continuato a dormire.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
Muchas gracias,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ich muss echt müde gewesen sein,
dass ich im Stehen eingeschlafen
bin.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Danke, dass du mich aufgeweckt
hast,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ayakta uyuyacak kadar
yorulmuş olmalıyım.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sen uyandırmasaydın,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} yine
uykuya dalacaktım.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
Teşekkür ederim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Isn't your face a bit too close,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}? Scooch back!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Bueno, bueno,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ni que no hubieras
visto a nadie durmiendo nunca,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}. ¡No es para tanto!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Wolltest du dich etwa an mich
ranschleichen, als ich geschlafen
hab,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Yüzün biraz fazla yakın değil mi,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}? Biraz geri çekil!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Haven't you ever heard that it's
dangerous to wake a sleeping
{{TAG:0005:001F:00CD}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ah, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, ma non lo sai
che è pericoloso svegliare
{{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:0005:001F:00CD}} che dorme?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Uyuyan bir
{{TAG:0005:001F:00CD}}'ı{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} uyandırmanın tehlikeli olduğunu
hiç duymadın mı, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
